lines.text: Nate leaves his water filter in the side pocket on a frosty night.
A filter that freezes while wet can crack inside, and you can't see the damage.
Here's the fix. Shake it out after use,
keep it in an inside pocket by day,
and in your sleeping bag at night.
If it ever freezes wet, replace it.
Nate sips filtered stream water by the fire.
Save this before your next cold trip.
